from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section2Scene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup Title and Layout
        title = Text("The Local Scaling Factor", font_size=36, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        subtitle = Text("Derivatives as Transformations", font_size=24, color=BLUE_B).next_to(title, DOWN)
        
        self.play(Write(title))
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle))
        self.wait(0.5)

        # 2. Setup Input and Output Number Lines
        # We visualize the function f(x) = x^2
        input_line = NumberLine(
            x_range=[-1, 4, 1],
            length=8,
            include_numbers=True,
            label_direction=UP,
            color=WHITE
        ).shift(UP * 0.5)
        
        output_line = NumberLine(
            x_range=[-1, 10, 2],
            length=8,
            include_numbers=True,
            label_direction=DOWN,
            color=YELLOW_C
        ).shift(DOWN * 1.5)

        input_label = Text("Input Space (x)", font_size=20).next_to(input_line, LEFT, buff=0.5)
        output_label = Text("Output Space (f(x))", font_size=20, color=YELLOW_C).next_to(output_line, LEFT, buff=0.5)

        self.play(
            Create(input_line),
            Create(output_line),
            Write(input_label),
            Write(output_label)
        )

        # 3. Demonstrate the Mapping at x = 2
        # For f(x) = x^2, f(2) = 4. f'(2) = 4.
        x_val = 2
        f_x_val = x_val**2

        dot_input = Dot(input_line.n2p(x_val), color=BLUE)
        dot_output = Dot(output_line.n2p(f_x_val), color=YELLOW)
        
        mapping_arrow = Arrow(
            start=dot_input.get_center(),
            end=dot_output.get_center(),
            buff=0.1,
            color=GREY_B,
            stroke_width=2
        )

        self.play(FadeIn(dot_input))
        self.play(GrowArrow(mapping_arrow))
        self.play(FadeIn(dot_output))
        self.wait(0.5)

        # 4. Local Scaling Visualization (dx and df)
        dx = 0.2
        f_x_plus_dx = (x_val + dx)**2
        df = f_x_plus_dx - f_x_val

        dot_input_step = Dot(input_line.n2p(x_val + dx), color=BLUE_E)
        dot_output_step = Dot(output_line.n2p(f_x_plus_dx), color=YELLOW_E)

        brace_input = BraceBetweenPoints(dot_input.get_center(), dot_input_step.get_center(), UP, buff=0.1)
        brace_output = BraceBetweenPoints(dot_output.get_center(), dot_output_step.get_center(), DOWN, buff=0.1)

        text_dx = MathTex(r"dx", font_size=24).next_to(brace_input, UP, buff=0.05)
        text_df = MathTex(r"df", font_size=24, color=YELLOW_C).next_to(brace_output, DOWN, buff=0.05)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(dot_input_step),
            Create(brace_input),
            Write(text_dx)
        )
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(dot_output_step),
            Create(brace_output),
            Write(text_df)
        )

        # 5. The Formula for Scaling Factor
        scaling_formula = MathTex(
            r"\text{Scaling Factor} = \frac{df}{dx} \approx f'(x)",
            font_size=32
        ).to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.5)
        
        bg_rect = SurroundingRectangle(scaling_formula, color=BLUE, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(Write(scaling_formula))
        self.play(Create(bg_rect))
        
        # Highlight that df is ~4 times larger than dx at this point
        explanation = Text(
            f"At x={x_val}, the space is stretched by a factor of {2*x_val}", 
            font_size=22, 
            color=YELLOW
        ).next_to(bg_rect, UP)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(explanation))
        self.wait(2)

        # Cleanup
        self.play(
            *[FadeOut(mob) for mob in self.mobjects]
        )
